commands: Run producer.py twice with immutable --producer-commit 7c154c525905df95ac632f5566cb39ed764e4793 and distinct exclusive output directories using the pinned read-only Python runtime. Both actual commands and observed execution times/outcomes are retained.

Run controls.py, verify.py over each complete run, compare full verified scientific hashes over both actual complete trees, then retain-run.py for each complete run. Byte retention/readback is not a third scientific execution.

conclusions.text: The complete 2337-family / 15611-component package reproduces every bound historical full row and preserves 421 unapproved source-geometry witnesses and 22 numerical-consistency unknowns. This is package1; the full global goal remains unfinished.

Source coverage does not prove dated land, water, administrative ownership, the original processing cause, or a safe repair. Complete global remainder 6,023 families / 37,388 components remains separately retained; durable full plan is retained in this package.

methods.description: Exact ordinary gzip/source-part aliases, full raw source concatenation and hash checks, complete family membership, original whole-file/ordinal row equality and lossless full-pointset union-object retention. Numerical producer/input closure was frozen before both complete executions. Retain-run is separate byte transport only.
methods.units: whole file bytes, canonical records, exact full pointsets, complete member counts

methods.description: Complete source-product bbox queries and every literal GEOS source intersection/covers operation, whole candidate union/intersection/difference, zero-area contacts and explicit numerical consistency diagnostics. No rounding epsilon, snapping, wrapping, normalization or repair.
methods.units: literal longitude/latitude coordinate-unit squared areas and coordinate-unit lengths; not ellipsoidal m² or metres
